The site was Southgate. I replied in the incident channel thread under your message.

The 2025-09-03 update from Priyanka in #inc-tansley-carrier-api says label printing stalled at Tansley Parcel depots, and that Southgate dispatch had totes stacked by door 4. Labels were printing again by 18:43 that day, after Southgate cleared the backlog. The channel doesn't name a site address, so if the customer call needs one, check the account file.
